card.name: Linking words before toxicity grading scales
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, with, the, a) right after 'graded', 'according', or 'in accordance', just before a named grading scale such as NCI CTC or Common Terminology Criteria. Seen in oncology adverse-reaction and dose-modification text.

modes.label: according to / in accordance with
modes.description: The linking word after 'according' or 'accordance' that introduces the NCI grading criteria.
modes.example: Severity grade according<< to>> National Cancer Institute Common Terminology Criteria for

modes.label: graded using / by the
modes.description: The article after 'graded using' or 'graded by' that leads into a named toxicity scale.
modes.example: Other toxicities were graded by<< the>> NCI CTC, Version 2

modes.label: article before baseline status
modes.description: The article after 'patients with' that leads into a baseline performance status.
modes.example: patients with<< a>> baseline performance status of 2 than in
